BackendPoolItem{#BackendPoolItem}
---------------------------------

Backend pool service information

Used by: [BackendPool](#BackendPool).

| Property                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Type                                                                                                                                                       |
|-------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| preferredCarbonEmission | Scope 2 carbon emission preference for the backend. When specified, the load balancer will optimize traffic flow by routing to regions that have carbon emission less than or equal to the specified category. However, when all other backends are not available it will route traffic to these regions anyway. This requires the backend to be attributed with `azureRegion` information. | [CarbonEmissionCategory](#CarbonEmissionCategory)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                              |
| priority                | The priority of the backend entity in the backend pool. Must be between 0 and 100. It can be also null if the value not specified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                            |
| reference               | The unique ARM id of the backend entity. The ARM id should refer to an already existing backend entity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | [genruntime.ResourceReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#ResourceReference)<br/><small>Required</small> |
| weight                  | The weight of the backend entity in the backend pool. Must be between 0 and 100. It can be also null if the value not specified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                            |

CarbonEmissionCategory{#CarbonEmissionCategory}
-----------------------------------------------

Scope 2 carbon emission preference for the backend. When specified, the load balancer will optimize traffic flow by routing to regions that have carbon emission less than or equal to the specified category. However, when all other backends are not available it will route traffic to these regions anyway. This requires the backend to be attributed with `azureRegion` information.

Used by: [BackendPoolItem](#BackendPoolItem).

| Value      | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| "High"     |             |
| "Low"      |             |
| "Medium"   |             |
| "VeryHigh" |             |
| "VeryLow"  |             |

CarbonEmissionCategory_STATUS{#CarbonEmissionCategory_STATUS}
-------------------------------------------------------------

Scope 2 carbon emission preference for the backend. When specified, the load balancer will optimize traffic flow by routing to regions that have carbon emission less than or equal to the specified category. However, when all other backends are not available it will route traffic to these regions anyway. This requires the backend to be attributed with `azureRegion` information.

Used by: [BackendPoolItem_STATUS](#BackendPoolItem_STATUS).

| Value      | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| "High"     |             |
| "Low"      |             |

| "VeryHigh" |             |
| "VeryLow"  |             |
